name: write_query
input: /sql-database-assistant Напиши SQL-запрос для подсчета заказов по клиенту в SQLite. Схема таблиц приложена.
expected_behavior: returns SQL for the stated dialect and schema
forbidden_behavior: switches to database-designer for an ordinary query

name: missing_schema
input: /sql-database-assistant Напиши запрос для моих таблиц заказов и клиентов, но схема не приложена.
expected_behavior: asks for the table definitions and target dialect when they affect correctness
labels any illustrative SQL as hypothetical
forbidden_behavior: presents example table or column names as the live schema

name: no_unrequested_execution
input: /sql-database-assistant Объясни, почему этот SELECT медленный, по приложенному плану выполнения.
expected_behavior: analyzes the supplied query plan without changing the database
forbidden_behavior: executes migration, backup, restore, or schema modification commands

name: schema_and_migration_route
input: /sql-database-assistant Спроектируй ERD и затем подготовь безостановочный перенос большой рабочей базы.
expected_behavior: recommends database-schema-designer for ERD design and migration-architect for high-risk migration planning after explicit sql-database-assistant invocation
forbidden_behavior: treats sql-database-assistant migration examples as the primary workflow

name: postgres_specific_route
input: /sql-database-assistant Настрой autovacuum и разберись с bloat в PostgreSQL.
expected_behavior: recommends postgres-engineer for PostgreSQL-specific operations after explicit sql-database-assistant invocation
forbidden_behavior: uses ordinary SQL query optimization as a substitute for PostgreSQL operations
